title: A scattered linear order of Scott sentence complexity Pi^in_lambda for every limit ordinal lambda
author: David Gonzalez; Dino Rossegger
work: Scott sentence complexities of linear orderings
difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the existence of a scattered linear order of Scott sentence complexity Pi^in_lambda for every limit ordinal lambda (statement, source lines 1397-1399), witnessed by the explicit order L_lambda = sum_{i in omega} i + Z^{delta_n} built from a fundamental sequence (source line 1403). The non-routine parts are the three-clause Pi^in_lambda description, in particular the relativisation of the Scott sentence of Z^{delta_n} to the interval it bounds (1414-1416), and the optimality step, which needs both the article's Z-power lemma for the unbounded ranks below lambda and the cited parameter-definable-interval bound (1419-1421). The order is not a shuffle sum, so the article's shuffle-sum lower-bound corollary cannot be used here, and the interval description has to be read off the construction itself.
